name: One-Pot Tomato Chickpea Rice
summary: Chickpeas and rice cooked together in a spiced tomato base. One pot, vegan.
instructions: Heat the oil in a pot with a lid over medium heat. Cook the onion 4 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin, and paprika for 30 seconds.
Add the diced tomatoes, chickpeas, rice, and 500 mL water. Season with salt and stir.
Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to low. Simmer 15 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Turn off the heat and let it sit, covered, 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
Top with green onions and pepper and serve.

glutenFree.notes: All ingredients are naturally gluten-free. Check any spice blend for wheat-based fillers.

budgetNotes: One pot, pantry ingredients — one of the cheapest full meals on the site.
A squeeze of lemon or a spoon of yogurt brightens it.
Add frozen peas or spinach in the last few minutes for more vegetables.
